Concentric circles are one of those patterns that look harmless until they’re repeated enough times to start doing weird things to your eyes. This piece is all colored sand: pink, purple, blue, green, yellow, orange, red stacked ring after ring around a tiny dark center. The shape stays perfectly circular, but the illusion doesn’t. Depending on where you focus, it reads like a tunnel, a spinning disc, a hypnotic target, or a hole opening up in the middle. I think what makes this one work is how little it needs.
